prompt: A conceptual diagrammatic illustration depicting a luminous, rectangular sliding frame labeled as the active "context window" overlaid onto a continuous horizontal ribbon of modular, interlocking text blocks representing "tokens" flowing toward a central AI processing core. Inside the illuminated frame, both the latest user prompt and recent conversation history appear sharp, vibrant, and actively linked by glowing neural lines to the processor. As the ribbon advances, older blocks pushed outside the frame's trailing edge visibly crumble, dissolve into dust, and fade into dark empty space to depict information loss and the strict capacity limit. Simultaneously, a bypass conduit routes select foundational data blocks away from this erasure zone into a separate, structured external database vault, which uses a targeted retrieval beam to feed persistent rules back into the model, clearly contrasting the AI’s finite immediate working memory with specialized external storage architectures.
